name: injection-evaluation-exclusions
purpose: Projects that may not be used as injection-evaluation (B) projects. The frozen development exclusion list and held-out rubric are unchanged; this is a separate snapshot for B.
finalize_before: opening the first B evaluation project; T6 projects and development-injection projects must be added at that point
rules: A listed project, its forks and its parent repository are excluded.

A candidate is in the same circuit family, and therefore excluded, if it contains a .circom file byte-identical to a .circom file of a listed project, ignoring standard dependency libraries such as circomlib.
Injection sites are limited to the evaluation project's own templates; dependency libraries such as circomlib are never mutated.
